question: What are the ids , names , prices , and colors of all products that have been listed in less than two orders ?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "products" AS SELECT "product_id" AS "product_id", "product_name" AS "product_name", "product_price" AS "product_price", "product_color" AS "product_color" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "order_items" AS SELECT "order_item_id" AS "order_item_id", "product_id" AS "product_id", "order_id" AS "order_id" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH product_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS distinct_order_count
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
)
SELECT
    p.product_id AS product_id,
    p.product_name AS product_name,
    p.product_price AS product_price,
    p.product_color AS product_color
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN product_order_counts poc
    ON p.product_id = poc.product_id
WHERE COALESCE(poc.distinct_order_count, 0) < 2
ORDER BY p.product_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH cleaned_products AS (
    SELECT 
        -- Extract first integer from product_id text like "[2, 5]" or plain "3"
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), '(?<!\d)(\d+)(?!\d)'),
                NULL
            ) AS BIGINT
        ) AS product_id_int,
        product_id AS raw_product_id,
        product_name,
        product_price,
        product_color
    FROM products
), product_order_counts AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id AS product_id_int, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS distinct_order_count
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
)
SELECT 
    cp.product_id_int AS product_id,
    cp.product_name,
    cp.product_price,
    cp.product_color
FROM cleaned_products cp
LEFT JOIN product_order_counts poc
    ON cp.product_id_int = poc.product_id_int
WHERE COALESCE(poc.distinct_order_count, 0) < 2
  AND cp.product_id_int IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cp.product_id_int

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH prod_parsed AS (
    SELECT
        -- Extract first numeric token from product_id text like "[2, 5]" or plain "3"
        TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), '(\d+)') AS BIGINT) AS product_id_int,
        -- If product_name looks like a list (starts with '['), try to take first quoted chunk; else use as-is
        COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(product_name AS VARCHAR), "'([^']+)"), ''), CAST(product_name AS VARCHAR)) AS product_name_scalar,
        -- Extract first decimal number from price; else fallback to original text
        COALESCE(TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(product_price AS VARCHAR), '(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)') AS DOUBLE), NULL) AS product_price_num,
        CAST(product_color AS VARCHAR) AS product_color_scalar
    FROM products
), product_order_counts AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id AS product_id_int, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS distinct_order_count
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
)
SELECT 
    pp.product_id_int AS product_id,
    pp.product_name_scalar AS product_name,
    pp.product_price_num AS product_price,
    pp.product_color_scalar AS product_color
FROM prod_parsed pp
LEFT JOIN product_order_counts poc
  ON pp.product_id_int = poc.product_id_int
WHERE COALESCE(poc.distinct_order_count, 0) < 2
  AND pp.product_id_int IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pp.product_id_int
S:

    SELECT
        -- Extract first numeric token from product_id text like "[2, 5]" or plain "3"
        TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), '(\d+)') AS BIGINT) AS product_id_int,
        -- If product_name looks like a list (starts with '['), try to take first quoted chunk; else use as-is
        COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(product_name AS VARCHAR), "'([^']+)"), ''), CAST(product_name AS VARCHAR)) AS product_name_scalar,
        -- Extract first decimal number from price; else fallback to original text
        COALESCE(TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(CAST(product_price AS VARCHAR), '(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)') AS DOUBLE), NULL) AS product_price_num,
        CAST(product_color AS VARCHAR) AS product_color_scalar
    FROM products
), product_order_counts AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id AS product_id_int, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS distinct_order_count
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
)
SELECT 
    pp.product_id_int AS product_id,
    pp.product_name_scalar AS product_name,
    pp.product_price_num AS product_price,
    pp.product_color_scalar AS product_color
FROM prod_parsed pp
LEFT JOIN product_order_counts poc
  ON pp.product_id_int = poc.product_id_int
WHERE COALESCE(poc.distinct_order_count, 0) < 2
  AND pp.product_id_int IS NOT NULL

'''
